common.bottomUse: Only deliberate short crossover or documented corridor. Avoid bottom route under critical TOP clocks/data and do not turn solid2L ground into long parallel slots.

reference.2L: Actual BOTTOM GND. Every new signal/power slot requires regenerated connected ground and nearby TOP GND crossing/ground stitching where needed; no quiet-island crossing.
reference.4L: Actual L2 GND forTOP. BOTTOM requires actual L3 GND after02d, not layer-name intent. Crossing reference/island boundary is forbidden unless explicit return reviewed.

common.layerTransition: L28_VIA030_C060 only; add nearbyGNDvia that reaches same actual common reference, avoid isolated HSE island. Via targetdistance<=1.5mm is teachingreviewtarget notSI/EMIcert; export actual offset and plane path.
common.spacing: Use actual group CSet/classclass; normaldigital .2, power.3, SW.5 and SW-sensitive1.0; USB-digitalisolation .5 unless expressly reviewed finepitchregion. No global spacing relaxation to clear congestion.
common.edgeRate: Baud/clock frequency alone does not set edge rate. Firmware must choose lowest adequate GPIO outputspeed and verify voltage/timing; no firmware implemented, no assumed2MHz slew guarantee.
common.length: Direct, few bends, avoid coils. Report actual net/pin-to-pin path lengths and branch lengths. No universal matching on unrelated UART/I2C/SWD nets.
forbiddenCorridors: HSE quietground island and its moat
common.powerSeparation: No digital main supply through .25 MCU pad escapes. Header combined external current remains10mA total; V3V3 normal150mA/Ta0..40C thermal unverified.
